text.playwright.config.ts: Configures serial Electron browser tests and exact visual snapshots
text.pnpm-workspace.yaml: Includes local packages and enables deployable injected workspace dependencies
text.tsconfig.json: Sets strict TypeScript checking for main, preload, shared and renderer sources and declares the @shared, @main and @renderer import aliases
text.vitest.config.ts: Configures unit tests, process cleanup, coverage, the import aliases and loading .svg imports as text
